description: This file defines a class 'FormatWithDate' implementing 'ValueFormatter' interface. It provides a method to format date values into 'Y-m-d' string format if the input is a DateTime object.

classes.name: FormatWithDate
classes.description: A formatter class that converts DateTime objects into 'Y-m-d' string format.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the formatted date string if input is a DateTime object; otherwise returns null.
